name: analyze
task: SELECT -> ANALYZE: evaluate the complete reviewed corpus, source fidelity, relationships, qualifications, and candidates.

name: frame
task: FRAME: establish editorial units, reader promises, narrative spines, support, and branches to omit before prose.

name: draft
task: DRAFT: write the editorial body from the approved frame.

name: structural-edit
task: STRUCTURAL EDIT: repair thought, progression, source relationships, and selection before sentence polish.

name: clarity-edit
task: CLARITY EDIT: make context, mechanisms, references, and claims understandable.

name: voice-edit
task: VOICE & NATURALNESS EDIT: apply the selected style and audit pattern density without changing approved meaning.

name: compression-edit
task: COMPRESSION EDIT: remove secondary branches and repetition only after understanding is secure.

name: final-polish
task: FINAL POLISH: complete the publication and source-fidelity checks.

name: render
task: Render final-approved prose into the selected profile and template without editorial rewriting.
